ai-module.description: Routes spectrum and search queries through Strernary™ DJL inference on port 20000.

table.name: word_bank
table.description: Core word bank — term, definition, specialness, radix, spelling variant, author, timestamps.

table.name: dolyene_spectrum
table.description: Dolyene spectrum data — int discipline indices, spelling conditions, weights, radix conditions.

table.name: county_precedent
table.description: County (full capitalized term of precedent) — pointers, indirections, revisions, caliber.

table.name: revisions
table.description: Immutable revision log — old/new definitions, revisionist IDs, timestamps.

command.name: DEFINE
command.description: Get full definition of a term from word bank

command.name: LOOKUP
command.description: Search by spelling, radix, or variant

command.name: ADD
command.description: Add new term to word bank

command.name: HISTORY
command.description: Get revision history for a term

command.name: WORDBANK
command.description: List all terms in word bank
